title: SEAM Route Fragment Authentication Extensions
description: JSON Schema for SEAM authentication and credential extension fields. Extracted from the main route-fragment-schema.json for focused validation of auth-specific extensions: x-vault-path, x-inject-as, x-required-scope, and x-credential-probe.

x-vault-path.$comment: Fragment-root. Which OpenBao secret to fetch. Paired with x-inject-as (both or neither).

x-inject-as.$comment: Fragment-root. How to inject the secret. Paired with x-vault-path (both or neither).

x-required-scope.$comment: Optional fragment-root DEFAULT; any operation-level x-required-scope REPLACES it (validator-side), never merges. Conjunctive array; bare string sugar for one element.

x-credential-probe.$comment: Fragment-root. A designated safe request + per-fragment probe interval. Forbidden on a pass-through fragment (one declaring neither x-vault-path nor x-inject-as).

vaultPath.description: OpenBao secret path for credential storage. Must resolve inside the allowlist prefix seam/routes/* and be co-owned with the fragment owner (seam/routes/<owner>/*).

allOf.description: Path traversal (..) is rejected for security.
Glob patterns are rejected to prevent directory enumeration.
Templated segments are rejected to prevent injection attacks.

injectAs.description: Defines how a credential from Vault is injected into upstream requests.

kind.description: Injection method: header (custom header), bearer (Authorization: Bearer), query (query parameter).

name.description: Header or query parameter name. Required for kind=header and kind=query, forbidden for kind=bearer.

allOf.description: Bearer injection uses standard Authorization header; name must be omitted.

scopeString.description: Colon-delimited service:action scope (e.g., k8s-ro:get, argocd:sync). At least two segments; supports three-segment control-plane scopes (seam:ops:read, seam:scopes:read-all).

scopeArray.description: Conjunctive set of scopes a caller must hold. A bare string is sugar for a one-element array.

oneOf.description: Array of scopes; must have at least one element with no duplicates.

duration.description: Time duration: number followed by unit (s=seconds, m=minutes, h=hours, d=days). No calendar-aligned forms (mo/y).

credentialProbe.description: Defines a health check request to validate credential viability against the upstream service.

path.description: A designated safe upstream path for health checking. Must be a route the fragment serves.

method.description: HTTP method for the probe request.

interval.description: Per-fragment probe interval. An x-upstream-map entry may override per instance.

constraint-vault-inject-paired.description: x-vault-path and x-inject-as must be declared together or omitted together. A fragment with neither is a pass-through proxy route.
constraint-vault-inject-paired.comment: This constraint prevents partial credential configuration where only the source or injection method is defined.

constraint-passthrough-has-no-probe.description: A pass-through route (no credential injection) cannot have a credential probe, since there is no credential to validate.
